name: Relevance
description: How relevant is the response to the context and the previous conversation?

name: Coherence
description: How coherent and logical is the response?

name: Engagement
description: How engaging and interesting is the response?

name: Contextual Understanding
description: How well does the response demonstrate an understanding of the context and the conversation?

name: Response Adequacy
description: How adequate is the response in terms of providing a suitable answer or continuation?
